answer.rationale: With 300 employees, the establishment exceeds the 250-employee threshold under §1904.41(a)(1)(ii), triggering mandatory electronic submission of Form 300A. The establishment must also complete the standard year-end recordkeeping cycle: recording work-related injuries/illnesses (§1904.4(a), §1904.31(a)), entering them within 7 days (§1904.29(b)(3)), creating and certifying the annual summary (§1904.32(a)(2)-(3)), posting it (§1904.32(a)(4), §1904.32(b)(5)), and retaining records for five years (§1904.33(a)). The 20-249 employee electronic submission rule (REC-026) does not apply since the establishment exceeds 249 employees and falls under the 250+ threshold instead.
